findings.summary: The active Graph token is checked against its JWT tenant and the authenticated Graph organization verified-domain match before any customer POST; a mismatched ambient context refuses before mutation.
The broker uses non-persistent contexts with a run-scoped engine root, a scrubbed child environment, stale-root refusal, and cleanup failure classified as indeterminate rather than Pass.
The authorization reference and PeerSlate auth issuer are non-echoing worker inputs, and no prompted issuer reaches Azure CLI or Chromium child arguments or inherited environments.
Focused tests inject Graph, browser, and retirement fakes and globally block default subprocess, network, Playwright, and SQL paths.
